headline: Disproved S195's OG-rasterizer deferral with a live sharp probe and shipped 46 bespoke per-title social cards — plus collection schema on the journal listings.

items.title: Bespoke per-title OG cards at build time (sharp we already own)
items.insight: The site's pitch is that a shared link sells the studio, yet ~48 pages still shared one generic card after S194 — a game link looked the same as the privacy policy. S195 shelved the fix for a dependency risk that didn't exist: sharp was already installed and rasterizes the OG SVG straight to PNG. Now every shared link carries a card that names its actual page, at zero new supply-chain cost.
items.evidence: 46 PNGs in assets/og/ (1200x630 verified); check-og-images: 124 pages all real rasters; footgun update-og-images.mjs guarded; build:check EXIT 0

items.title: CollectionPage + ItemList on the journal/changelog listing pages
items.insight: The journal entries already had Article schema, but the listing pages declared a bare Blog node with zero posts inside it, so a crawler saw a pile of links instead of a publication. The new injector derives the post list from the entries' own schema and declares the journal, archive, dispatches and changelog as collections with their 10 dated posts enumerated. A build gate now fails if a new post isn't reflected, so it can't silently rot.
items.evidence: inject-collection-jsonld.mjs 9/9 self-test; 4 listing pages carry CollectionPage; --check drift-gate folded into check-proof-surface

followUps: Prod-verify the bespoke OG cards + collection schema via the FB/X social debuggers (never assume push==deploy)
